message:
So:
- `ndpi_no_tunnel = 0`, `ndpi_gre_tunnel = 6`, so range = 7, consumes 1 byte
- `NDPI_PROTOCOL_CATEGORY_CUSTOM_1 = 20`, `NDPI_PROTOCOL_NUM_CATEGORIES` is probably around 30, so range is about 11, consumes 1 byte

Now let me also check `ndpi_get_num_protocols` - it returns `num_supported_protocols`. Let me check what that value is:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>grep -n "num_supported_protocols" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src/lib/ndpi_main.c | head -10</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
